rootCauses.summary: The shared brand boot stylesheet contains literal backslash-n text between loader and animation rules, causing CSS parsing to break after the progress bar rule.
rootCauses.prediction: Replacing the literal escape text with real source newlines keeps the logo/wordmark animation, loader, ready transition and TAP rules in one valid stylesheet.
rootCauses.falsifier: The source still contains literal backslash-n before selectors or the animation/touch rules are no longer present.

rootCauses.summary: Immutable demon staging shows a white field and thin progress line while the scorpion mark and PARALYZE AREA wordmark remain invisible during boot.
rootCauses.prediction: Same-condition staging after the CSS repair shows the branded mark/wordmark during loading and preserves progress/TAP handoff.
rootCauses.falsifier: The fixed staging still renders only the progress line or loses loader/TAP feedback.

observation.summary: Current immutable demon staging reaches version.json for exact develop but visually collapses to a blank white field with only the thin loader visible. Source inspection identifies literal backslash-n tokens inside the shared boot stylesheet immediately before animation rules.

conditions.scenario: cold open with ?review=1, no user input before first screenshot

notVerified: Post-TAP hunt interaction in the failed baseline run

evidence.statement: Seven literal backslash-n sequences are embedded in the CSS template between loader/animation selectors, while logo and wordmark begin at opacity zero and depend on later keyframes.
Demon intentionally runs application load under the shared brand gate, so the shared stylesheet directly controls what the player sees throughout boot.

hypothesis.cause: The new progress-loader edit inserted escaped newline text into CSS source instead of real newlines, invalidating later animation rules and hiding the intended brand while load continues.
hypothesis.prediction: A source-only newline repair plus regression assertion restores branded loading without changing readiness scheduling, audio unlock, gameplay bootstrap, or hunt systems.
hypothesis.falsifier: Focused native assertion fails, boot scheduling changes, or fixed staging still shows the blank loader-only state.

candidates.reason: Fixes the exact parser defect while preserving the current brand design, readiness-aware load contract, and all gameplay code.
Would discard approved animation/identity and mask the parser defect instead of repairing it.

implementation.summary: Replace literal backslash-n tokens in the boot-gate stylesheet with real newlines and extend the existing demon native boot regression to reject this parser-breaking form.

limitations: Native assertion proves stylesheet source integrity, not cross-browser visual fidelity.
After staging will verify player-visible brand restoration; physical-device timing remains unmeasured.
